The useful details

Before you
ask.

What’s included in the $999?+

A custom website with the agreed core pages, responsive layouts, enquiry journey, basic search metadata, and launch support. We confirm the page count, integrations, revision rounds and timeline in a written proposal before invoicing.

Can I buy straight away?+

Start with the project brief. We confirm fit and scope, then send an invoice with payment instructions. Nothing is charged by this website, and sending a brief creates no payment obligation.

What is the $89 monthly care plan?+

Care starts in month two if included in your agreement. The proposal spells out hosting responsibilities, maintenance, the allowance for small updates, cancellation terms, and any outside service fees.

Can you refresh my existing website?+

Yes. Share your current link and what feels out of date. We’ll work out whether a focused redesign or a fresh build makes more sense.

Are these real client websites?+

The eight sites are fictional design concepts created to demonstrate different industries and styles. Their booking and enquiry forms are local demos, and their businesses are not operating services.

Will my site work well on a phone?+

Mobile layouts are part of the build, along with keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support, image optimization, and checks of the core enquiry journey.
